Hero_Desc_Ricota:
A Sprite who studied abroad in Monatium to become a chef.
Her suspicious dishes and frightening appearance often cause misunderstandings.
She takes great pride in her cooking and constantly researches new recipes.
Album_Like_Ricota: Excellent dishes that satisfy her palate
Album_Hate_Ricota: People dismissing her cooking, putting pineapple on pizza
Album_Hobby_Ricota: Developing new dishes with a variety of ingredients
Album_Wish_Ricota: For every Sprite to acknowledge her cooking
Album_Ricota1: Ricota is a chef Sprite who runs a restaurant in the Sprite Kingdom's shopping district. Recently, she was also selected to serve as a royal chef.
Album_Ricota2: Unlike the other Sprites, who are satisfied as long as they have sweet bread, Ricota is deeply serious about cooking. She wants to reform every Sprite's simplistic eating habits someday... but could that truly be possible?
Album_Ricota3: Surprisingly, Ricota's cooking is well regarded in the Sprite Kingdom. Apparently, however, anyone visiting to try it must observe a long list of precautions... What could that possibly mean?
Album_Ricota4: At last, I was able to taste Ricota's cooking. It retained the distinctive sweetness favored by Sprites, but I could sense how much thought she had given to producing a variety of flavors. But what is this... ring-like object inside it?
Album_Ricota5: I later heard a terrifying rumor that Ricota uses Sprites she dislikes as ingredients in her cooking. Surely, even she would never do such a thing... She would not, right?
Album_Ricota6: Ricota is even sharper and more serious in the banquet hall than usual. Whenever I watch her place one of my dishes in her mouth and slowly taste it, my palms begin sweating on their own.
Album_Ricota7: I asked Ricota about her future goals. Once everyone in the Sprite Kingdom recognizes her cooking, she wants to open restaurants in other regions of Elias and challenge herself there. I decided to support her wonderful ambition with all my heart.
LoveHero_Ricota: As the finest chef, I can now cook together with you, Master!
LoveHeroCancel_Ricota: Even if the gourmand leaves, the work I must do remains unchanged...
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Hate1: Ricota chewed a single piece of feed, twisted her face into a scowl, and spat it straight out. She then spent over ten minutes passionately declaring that such a thing was absolutely not food.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Hate2: Ricota retched the moment she saw the space rations. She shuddered as they brought back the nightmare of living in a tiny room as a student abroad and eating them for ages to save money.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like1: She liked that the wrap fit conveniently into one bite and used fresh ingredients. Ricota was curious about where I had obtained ingredients this fresh.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like10: She said the tart flavor would pair well with a recipe she was researching. She repeatedly insisted that I must attend when she invited me after completing the new dish.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like2: She judged it an excellent dish for captivating even her demanding palate. Particularly curious about the secret of the sauce, she offered to exchange one of her own recipes for it.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like3: Fascinated by the chewy texture, Ricota fished a rice cake out of the soup and put it in a bag. When she said she would study it later, I stopped her and offered to explain the secret myself.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like4: She marveled that it was her first time seeing one in person and cleaned her plate. Perhaps the recipe never became known because Elves dislike Christmas.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like5: She liked the powder's distinctive flavor. She seemed excited by the prospect of using it to create a new sauce or dish.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like6: The soft, chewy texture seemed to shock her. After asking permission, Ricota cut the songpyeon apart on the spot and investigated even its filling.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like7: Being a Sprite, Ricota also enjoyed the Almond Rocher. After finishing it, she cheerfully proposed about ten possible improvements and declared that the dish showed promise.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like8: After tasting the powder, Ricota shouted 'Eureka!' and dashed outside. She returned later, packed up the remaining powder, and happily announced that she had conceived a new recipe.
Food_ChefNote_Ricota_Like9: She liked the harmonious flavor created by eating several different candies together. Right there, Ricota mixed them in various combinations and wrote down her recommendations.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Ricota: The finest dishes begin with the finest ingredients.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Ricota: Personally, I pride myself on being the finest chef.
Ricota_Spawn1: I shall simmer, boil, and stir-fry them all!
Ricota_Spawn2: Now! It is time to cook!
Ricota_Growth: I am Ricota, the finest chef.
Ricota_Growth1: As sharp as a freshly honed knife!
Ricota_Growth2: Fine ingredients are what make fine cuisine.
Ricota_Victory1: Hah! This is the power of a chef!
Ricota_Victory2: Kheh, khahaha! That is the extent of my skill!
Ricota_Defeat1: I have no excuse for disappointing you.
Ricota_Defeat2: I shall prepare lunch in the rear.
Ricota_Affinity1_1: You are hungry? Please wait just a moment.
Ricota_Affinity1_2: Is it to your taste? You are welcome to shower me with praise.
Ricota_Affinity2: You say it does not look very appetizing? One bite will put an end to such remarks.
Ricota_Affinity1_3: One day, I would like to present you with my finest dish.
Ricota_Affinity3: A chef will do anything in pursuit of a finer flavor.
Ricota_Affinity4: Who put pineapple on this pizza?! Show yourself at once!
Ricota_Affinity5: I do not reveal the secret of my flavors to just anyone. Knowing it could get you hurt.
Ricota_Affinity6: You find my cooking suspicious? Hmm, why does everyone think that?
Ricota_Affinity7: The ingredients in this dish? They are normally a secret, but I shall make a special exception for you, Master.
Ricota_Die1: I suppose I should go back and eat some bread...
Ricota_Die2: As expected, I am better at cooking than fighting...
Ricota_Equipment: They say a master never blames the tools, but good tools are always welcome!
Ricota_HeroSkill: A new recipe has come to me!
Ricota_HeroUpgrade: I shall repay this kindness with delicious food!
Ricota_Board: Are there good ingredients over there?
Ricota_DeckSetting2: A choice you will not regret.
Ricota_Stage: I shall simmer them all down!
Ricota_Touch1: Ugh, did the food not suit your taste?
Ricota_Touch1_1: Ugh, my cheeks are not rice cakes.
Ricota_Touch2_1: Next time, I shall serve you an even more delicious meal.
Ricota_Touch1_2: Hehe, they are springy like fresh ingredients, are they not?
Ricota_Touch2: It seems this dish suited your taste?
Ricota_Touch2_2: Would you care to dine together this evening?
Ricota_DutchRubEnd2: If the food tastes bad, just tell me!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Ricota_Skin1: Ricota says she challenged herself to prepare a high-society banquet today. She seems to have chosen a dress code to match the concept, only to become rather too immersed in the role.
Ricota_Growth1_Skin1: It seems I am the star of this party.
Ricota_LevelUp_Skin1: With this, I have become an even finer young lady.
Ricota_Equipment_Skin1: A young lady naturally requires fine clothes and pretty accessories.
Ricota_HeroSkill_Skin1: Hehe, now I can give anyone who displeases me a proper grilling.
Ricota_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: It would be troublesome if I became too glamorous~
Ricota_Board_Skin1: Shh! There is no need to rush me; I am going there.
Ricota_Touch1_Skin1: Ouch! I worked hard on my appearance, and now you will ruin it!
Ricota_Touch1_1_Skin1: Ugh, is this some advanced technique to attract my attention?
Ricota_Touch1_2_Skin1: Mm, I know~ You need not say a word; I understand exactly how you feel~
Ricota_Touch2_Skin1: Well, this is not an unpleasant feeling.
Ricota_Touch2_1_Skin1: If I must choose between liking and disliking it, I would say I like it.
Ricota_Touch2_2_Skin1: I shall be honest. Would you pet me a little more?
Ricota_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: How dare you strike a young lady! Such insolence!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Ricota_Skin2: Ricota has become the flight attendant responsible for in-flight meals aboard the Bread Cruiser. She appears ready to conquer not only Monatium and Erpien, but the skies themselves with her delicious cooking.
Ricota_Growth1_Skin2: Would you prefer the beef or the chicken?
Ricota_Growth2_Skin2: We have prepared in-flight meals suited to the tastes of every race.
Ricota_LevelUp_Skin2: Mmm~ Could I create a dish that tastes like clouds?
Ricota_Equipment_Skin2: A gift from a passenger! Thank you ever so much!
Ricota_HeroSkill_Skin2: A flying chef! This should be a wonderful experience.
Ricota_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: It seems the time has come to expand the kitchen aboard the Bread Cruiser.
Ricota_Board_Skin2: Yes! Coming right away! The menu is complete!
Ricota_Touch1_Skin2: Is something wrong with the food? Has it gone cold?
Ricota_Touch1_1_Skin2: I did not simply reheat something frozen before serving it! I swear!
Ricota_Touch1_2_Skin2: Please direct complaints about the menu to the captain, not me...!
Ricota_Touch2_Skin2: Ah— Was it truly that delicious? Thank you.
Ricota_Touch2_1_Skin2: Were you satisfied with the menu prepared for you, passenger?
Ricota_Touch2_2_Skin2: I-I shall make dessert for you as well. Please wait just a moment.
Ricota_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: No matter what you do, a luxurious full-course meal is impossible aboard the plane!
Aside_Get_Ricota1: I shall train until the day pineapple pizza disappears!
Aside_Upgrade_Ricota1: One step closer to my dream. Pineapple pizza, adios!
Ricota_AsideGet: I shall train until the day pineapple pizza disappears!
Ricota_AsideUpgrade: One step closer to my dream. Pineapple pizza, adios!
Ricota_Ultimate1: Perfect preparation is the foundation of fine cooking!
Ricota_Hit3: Ugh... Ugh... Ugh... Ugh... Ugh... Ugh... Ugh...
Ricota_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master. I have prepared a cake, so let us enjoy it together.
Ricota_Gacha2: Personally, I pride myself on being the finest chef.
Ricota_Gacha3: The finest dishes begin with the finest ingredients.
Ricota_Line1: I am Ricota, the finest chef in Elias.
Ricota_Line2: I always strive to create the finest cuisine.
Ricota_Line3: With this one ingredient, I can create a new dish!
Ricota_Lobby: I wonder if there is a new recipe somewhere?
Ricota_ThemeBattle01: It is delicious, so why does everyone react that way?
Ricota_ThemeBattle02: Do not look at me like that. I am not tearing pages out of a book to eat them.
Ricota_ThemeBattle03: My greatest masterpiece! Yes, this is true cuisine!
LoveLetter_Ricota:
Greetings, Master. This is Ricota.

Preparing food and feeding others is no simple task, so I greatly respect how you always converse with the Apostles in the banquet hall. It makes me want to work harder and become a chef who truly connects with her guests.

If there is any food you wish to eat, please tell me quietly. Even if I cannot recreate it exactly, I will use the full extent of my skill to ease your loneliness, Master.
LoveCall_Ricota:
Greetings, Master. This is Ri~cota.
Are you aware that your cooking has a special quality?
It contains the care you feel for the Apostles.
Perhaps that is why whenever I taste your cooking, I suddenly find myself thinking of you.
Ah, allow me to correct that. I think of you even on days when I do not eat your food.

It is entirely thanks to you that I adapted successfully to life as a chef in the Sprite Kingdom.
I remember when I first returned home.
Back then, nothing I cooked was popular.
Your help carried me through that slump as well.
If there is ever a dish you wish to eat, please tell me.
Nothing brings me greater joy than serving my cooking to you, Master. Thank you.
Affinity_Ricota_EP01_001: Hmm... This flavor... Did you use pepper?
Affinity_Ricota_EP01_002: What! Just what I would expect from Ricota!
Affinity_Ricota_EP01_003: Hehe. A cook must notice at least this much. Even a single peppercorn can upset the balance of a dish.
Affinity_Ricota_EP01_004: Hmm? Pepper? I never used any.
Affinity_Ricota_EP01_005: Hmm... You need to train your palate further, Master. Shall I help you?
Affinity_Ricota_EP01_007: Y-you... You must never make such a mistake! We are fortunate it was only a little pepper. If it had been another seasoning...!
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_001: I am curious about the food from the place where you lived, Master.
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_002: I want to eat... food from home...
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_003: Oh dear. Could you tell me what it tasted like? I will try making it for you as an apology.
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_004: Have you heard of monster cuisine?
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_005: M-monster cuisine? Ugh... The name alone makes it sound dreadful...
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_006: It is not so different from the food here.
Affinity_Ricota_EP02_007: Is that so? Hmm... The Elves came from Earth, did they not? Then I suppose it would be similar.
Affinity_Ricota_EP03_001: ...Ahem. It seems no one here observes proper table manners.
Affinity_Ricota_EP03_003: I wish everyone understood table manners better. Ah, I am not blaming you, Master.
Affinity_Ricota_EP03_005: Is... that so? Hmm... Yes. Perhaps this kind of commotion is another way to experience flavor. Hehe, I learned something again today.
Affinity_Ricota_EP03_006: I think you are overly sensitive.
Affinity_Ricota_EP03_007: I am overly sensitive? That goes a little too far. Table manners are important. Do you understand?
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_001: These tools... are rather old, are they not?
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_002: Ner says the budget is too small to replace them.
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_003: Oh dear. Hmm... The next time I meet High Priest Ner, I will make a suggestion.
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_004: They are tools I have cherished.
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_005: Hehe. So it seems. They are old, but their edges are well maintained... These tools have been loved.
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_006: As long as the knives cut well enough, that is sufficient.
Affinity_Ricota_EP04_007: What? But a dull knife damages the ingredients!
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_001: I want to develop a new menu, but I have lacked inspiration lately.
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_002: Have they been squeezing too much out of you lately?
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_003: Hmm... To be honest, perhaps they have. Preparing five meals a day plus all manner of snacks... Haaah.
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_004: Let us change our perspective a little.
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_005: Perspective... A change in perspective... This certainly is the moment when I need a new approach. Thank you.
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_006: Where would you find an inspiring old man around here? We do not even have Santa. Pfft—
Affinity_Ricota_EP05_007: What? I do not understand you. Why are you grinning while saying such strange things?
Affinity_Ricota_EP06_001: Her Majesty's picky eating... shows no sign of improving. Is it because I am inadequate?
Affinity_Ricota_EP06_002: Let us try a little harder.
Affinity_Ricota_EP06_003: Uuuh... But I am already running out of my many recipes...
Affinity_Ricota_EP06_005: What? Not at all. Hmm... This is something like my sense of duty as a chef.
Affinity_Ricota_EP06_006: No. Erpin... has always been like that.
Affinity_Ricota_EP06_007: Th-that cannot... No! Her Majesty can change! Please believe in her and wait too, Master!
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_001: I want to introduce the Sprites to more varied flavors and teach them true gastronomy.
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_002: I will support your grand dream!
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_003: Th-thank you. That leaves me feeling somewhat uneasy... but thank you for your support.
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_004: That will be an extremely difficult path...
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_005: Extremely difficult...? It is not quite that bad. The Sprites were not always like this!
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_006: Might it be... impossible for them...?
Affinity_Ricota_EP07_007: You lack faith, Master. But we cannot leave them this way either, can we? Please cooperate!
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_001: Could there be some new ingredient out there? Hmm~ Shall I visit the Beastfolk Forest...? It is difficult to decide.
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_002: I once saw a new mushroom in the Beastfolk Forest.
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_003: Truly? What did it look like? What was its aroma? Ah... It would be faster to examine it myself. Please tell me where it was.
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_004: That place is hopeless. Go to the Elemental Forest instead.
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_005: What...? Why? There are no ingredients left in the Beastfolk Forest? What? The entire ground has been dug up?
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_006: The darkest place is under the lamp. How about the Sprite Forest?
Affinity_Ricota_EP08_007: I have already finished examining everything there. Surely you did not think I would neglect something so obvious. You underestimate me.
Affinity_Ricota_EP09_001: I keep receiving messages from Monatium lately.
Affinity_Ricota_EP09_002: How about taking an occasional business trip?
Affinity_Ricota_EP09_003: Hmm... I had considered taking several days of leave to visit. But I must prepare Her Majesty's snacks, so I cannot find any time.
Affinity_Ricota_EP09_005: What? I have no intention of leaving for good. So please let go of my trouser leg before you speak. I mean it. I am not leaving.
Affinity_Ricota_EP09_006: If you move away, leave me your address first.
Affinity_Ricota_EP09_007: Could it be... that you want me to move away? I already heard rumors that the Banquet Hall has been deserted lately... Surely not?
Affinity_Ricota_EP10_001: What flavors do you prefer, Master?
Affinity_Ricota_EP10_003: Sometimes sweetness is essential to bring out other flavors. Something is not automatically bad merely because it is sweet.
Affinity_Ricota_EP10_004: As long as it tastes good.
Affinity_Ricota_EP10_005: What? Haaah... You cook too, Master, so you know that saying such a thing is actually... What? You are sorry?
Affinity_Ricota_EP10_006: The proper balance is always best.
Affinity_Ricota_EP10_007: Hmm~ I asked which flavor you prefer. But yes, a proper balance does produce excellent flavor.
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_001: The High Priest requested a new menu to address Her Majesty's picky eating.
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_002: How about sweet bean jelly cake?
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_003: Oh? Sweet bean jelly combined with cake! Would Her Majesty like it or hate it? I must make it immediately!
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_004: How about sweet bean jelly ice cream?
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_005: It seems worth attempting. Ah, you want to eat it too, Master? Could your age perhaps— Never mind.
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_006: How about sweet bean jelly steamed buns?
Affinity_Ricota_EP11_007: I have unpleasant memories involving steamed buns... My ribs still ache whenever it rains.
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_001: The Sprites tremble whenever they see me, and I do not know why.
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_002: Perhaps your cooking is too delicious?
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_003: It seems to be for a different reason, but I cannot tell what it is.
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_004: Smile at them once in a while! A smile is the best way to relieve tension!
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_005: They seem frightened whenever I look them in the eyes and smile... Hmm, understood. I will give it a try.
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_006: Did you feed the Sprites pineapple pizza?
Affinity_Ricota_EP12_007: How could you conceive of something so horrifying? Feed the Sprites pineapple pizza?!
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_001: Lately I have heard rumors that I cook with magic books.
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_002: Cooking with magic books? Wow! What a new approach!
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_003: Since the rumor already exists, shall we try it? Paper-wrapped meat sounds promising!
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_004: Could it be because you made something like molecular cuisine with a magic book?
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_005: Well, Sprites might misunderstand that. I should be more careful from now on.
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_006: A craftsperson always acquires a reputation for eccentricity!
Affinity_Ricota_EP13_007: Even so, I do not particularly wish to have that sort of reputation...
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_001: For some reason, I wish to cook with Yggdrasil's sap.
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_002: Do not. Ner will scold you.
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_003: Would it not be possible with your permission, Master? Ah, we might be sent to the Weekend Farm together? Then I abandon the idea.
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_004: If you ever make it, let me have a bite too...!
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_005: If I make it, I will certainly serve some to you.
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_006: Shall we try making it together?
Affinity_Ricota_EP14_007: A name for the dish has already occurred to me! When shall we begin?
Affinity_Ricota_EP15_001: Are there any foods you dislike, Master?
Affinity_Ricota_EP15_003: There certainly are those who value the original flavors of chocolate and mint. Still, it is unquestionably a novel attempt.
Affinity_Ricota_EP15_005: Exactly! It is food that must not exist! Let us go burn it at once!
Affinity_Ricota_EP15_007: I believe I now understand why you get along so well with Sprites, Master.
Affinity_Ricota_EP16_001: How do you know the favorite food of so many Apostles, Master?
Affinity_Ricota_EP16_003: I do not understand what you are saying.
Affinity_Ricota_EP16_004: I learned all of it through experience.
Affinity_Ricota_EP16_005: Nothing teaches as well as experience, indeed.
Affinity_Ricota_EP16_006: I never deliberately memorized any of it.
Affinity_Ricota_EP16_007: Then the Apostles must enjoy everything you cook!
Affinity_Ricota_EP17_001: I recently obtained a knife called the Tulip Knife. Have you heard of it?
Affinity_Ricota_EP17_003: Mayor Elena gave it to me as a farewell present. That is rather cruel...
Affinity_Ricota_EP17_004: Oh? I have one of those too.
Affinity_Ricota_EP17_005: Then we have matching kitchen knives! What? They cost only 39,800 gold online?
Affinity_Ricota_EP17_006: A craftsperson never blames their tools.
Affinity_Ricota_EP17_007: I was not blaming it, but you are correct.
Affinity_Ricota_EP18_001: I mixed sweet bean jelly with honey collected by Jubi and made fried rice.
Affinity_Ricota_EP18_003: Would you care to taste it? It is surprisingly good. Ah, you want me to eat plenty of it by myself?
Affinity_Ricota_EP18_005: Precisely. A chef must never lack an adventurous spirit!
Affinity_Ricota_EP18_007: Oh? Correct! Jubi No. 177 ordered it. Hmm? It also helps dispose of the sweet bean jelly, so that is good?
Affinity_Ricota_EP19_001: The Apostles wonder which of us is the more skilled cook, you or me, Master.
Affinity_Ricota_EP19_002: Come at me! I accept your challenge!
Affinity_Ricota_EP19_003: Haha! Excellent. Please show me what you can do, Master!
Affinity_Ricota_EP19_005: Certainly. What? Preparing three-minute cup noodles properly? Can that be a contest?
Affinity_Ricota_EP19_006: It hardly feels right to call me a cook...
Affinity_Ricota_EP19_007: Master, being a chef is not about qualifications or skill! Allow me to lecture you for a moment!
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_001: The Elves suggested opening a cooking channel on ElTube.
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_002: I would sooner trust Erpin than an Elf!
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_003: Her Majesty is certainly trustworthy. What? You disagree?
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_004: Surely they are not splitting the revenue fifty-fifty?
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_005: What? How did you know? You say I must never do it? I had no intention of doing it in the first place.
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_006: Would it not be better to keep your recipes private?
Affinity_Ricota_EP20_007: For the advancement of cuisine, I believe it would be acceptable.
